title: Practical Agricultural Prep for Spring Planting
reason: The video describes agricultural practices and land management.

tasks.task: Relocate and prepare a compost pile for improved soil quality.

subtasks.text: Observe the compost pile started in mid-October and intended for use in spring.
Describe the process of relocating the compost pile to a new area.
Note the location of the land that will be tilled and the items to be added to the soil.

tasks.task: Prepare the soil for planting during the "dead season".

subtasks.text: Watch the clearing of debris, rocks, and bricks from a recently acquired property.
Observe the testing of soil pH and the application of lime.
Note the transportation of compost, manure, and other materials to the work site.

tasks.task: Launch the homestead with various agricultural activities.

subtasks.text: Observe the intention to grow watermelons and the setup for planting.
